name: Algorithmic Bid, Budget & Negative Keyword Optimization
purpose: Apply deterministic optimization heuristics to reduce wasted spend, optimize target bids, add negative keywords, and rebalance daily pacing.
prerequisites: Recent audit data available (< 24 hours old)
Campaign has accumulated at least 30 conversions for algorithmic stability
Clear CPA and ROAS thresholds defined in client context

executionSteps.name: Add Negative Keywords on Google Search
executionSteps.action: Extract search terms with spend > 1.5x CPA and 0 conversions over past 14 days and append to campaign negative list

executionSteps.name: Prune Underperforming Ads & Ad Sets
executionSteps.action: Pause ads with CTR < 50% of campaign average and 0 conversions after exceeding $30 spend

executionSteps.name: Adjust Bid Targets & Cost Caps
executionSteps.action: Adjust tROAS or tCPA targets by +/- 5% to 15% maximum (never exceeding 20% in a single adjustment cycle to avoid reset of learning phase)

executionSteps.name: Verify Learning Phase Stability
executionSteps.action: Confirm changes did not push Meta or Google campaigns into 'Learning Limited' status

expectedOutputs: List of Paused Entities & Added Negative Keywords
successCriteria: All bid adjustments within +/- 15% safety boundary
Zero active campaigns unintentionally stopped or thrown into bid shock
Projected 10-25% reduction in wasted spend within 7 days

failureHandling.retryStrategy: Retry API update once on rate limit; abort and rollback if platform rejects bid mutation

rollbackStrategy: Revert all modified bid values and reactivate paused ads to their exact pre-optimization state from snapshot.
